## Release Notes

### Cause Management & Parking
- **#3759** (omnimarket): Default park ladder for spent shared cause—after two failures, one more `claude_opus` attempt with `prior_attempts`; third failure parks cause, emits `file_cause_ticket` once, no `escalate_operator`. Park ends when `base_heads` differs from `parked_base_head` (12-hour window fallback).
- **#2977** (omnimarket): Re-mint OCC companion conflicted by sibling landing; scheduled job publishes `occ-autobind` for conflicted per-PR companions.

### Snapshot & Projection
- **#3224** (omnimarket): Fix declared key column missing from relation—`TableRowSource` reads live columns once via `to_regclass($1)` cached, keys read only on declared columns the relation carries.
- **#1805** (omnibase_core): `onex-work-ledger --source projection|local|auto` with union fold; `auto` folds projection plus local tail (unconfirmed buffer events), on projection fault folds local-only or answers `UNDECIDED`; missing buffer never `CLEAR`.
- **#3682** (omnimarket): PR-state schema v2—`ModelPrStateObservedEventV2` carries per-check facts (check, conclusion, run_id, workflow, completed_at) for red contexts, plus `base_red_checks`/`base_read`; `ModelCiRunFailedEvent` gains `failing_runs`; triage reads from event, calls GitHub only when facts absent.

### Validator Infrastructure
- **#1889** (omnibase_core): Convert first validator batch to `node_<rule>_check_compute` packages emitting `ModelValidationReport` with golden verdict-parity tests; switches pre-commit/CI to them (no-env-fallbacks, ai-slop, skip-count ratchet, release identity, no-untyped-metadata, topic names, markdown links, local).
- **#1394** (omnibase_core): Close argv false-green in three `no-*` validator gates—parse flags vs paths, scan full tree, fail-closed on empty scope.
- **#1583** (omnibase_core): Type environment dependency convention—`EnumDependencyType` gains `ENVIRONMENT`; `ModelDependency` gains typed `env_var`; `_batch_convert_dict_dependencies` reads `env_var` and accepts `type:` key as alias when value names enum member.
- **#1796** (omnibase_core): `canonical_handler_shape` classifier resolves inherited `handle()`—inspects base class in sibling module, fixes misclassification (e.g., `node_pr_lifecycle_fix_effect`).

### CI Optimization
- **#1392** (omnibase_core): Remove `merge_group` trigger from 22 non-required workflows (canary); `pull_request`/`push` triggers untouched.
- **#1395** (omnibase_core): Remove 7 duplicate/superseded jobs from `omni-standards-compliance.yml` (naming-conventions, node-purity-check, etc.), keep 5 unique; none in `required_status_checks`.
- **#354** (omnibase_spi): Add `call-repo-evidence-gate.yml` triggering on `pull_request_target`; calls `receipt-gate.yml` pinned at sha `fb0c6c2`; starts S5 shadow count.
- **#1702** (omnibase_core): Release omnibase_core 0.47.17 (changelog entry only; dev already at version).

### Dependency Updates
- **#329** (omnibase_spi): Bump `OmniNode-ai/omniclaude/.github/workflows/hardcoded-model-config-reusable.yml` from `1ad181a` to `be0f241`.
- **#245** (omnibase_spi): Bump `actions/cache` from 5 to 6 (semver-major).
- **#1119** (omnibase_core): Bump `OmniNode-ai/onex_change_control` in actions group from `32a57e7` to `9f92bbe`.

### Security Gates
- **#1837** (omnibase_core): Add `node_direct_model_call_check_compute`—AST + import/call graph refuses HTTP to model endpoints, model CLIs (`crush`, `claude -p`), model SDK imports outside sanctioned packages; exports `check-direct-model-call` hook; shrink-only baseline in `.onex_ratchets/direct_model_call_baseline.yaml`.
- **#1821** (omnibase_core): URL Authority Gate sees DSN env reads—AST pass handles `os.getenv`, `from os import environ/getenv`, aliased imports, key via string constant/attribute; `_DSN` name shape added; widening surfaces recorded in burn-down seed file.
- **#1953** (omnibase_core): Retire skip-token approvals registry—receipt gate rejects every skip token; allowlist loader, expiry, scope, self-approval checks, flag, CLI, workflow arg, grant script removed; pre-commit hook rejects any skip token.
- **#3634** (omnimarket): Add `node_handshake_policy_gate_effect`—EFFECT node reads repo default branch + latest `check-handshake.yml` run from GitHub, asks compute for decisions, sleeps between retries, returns stdout/stderr/exit code/verdict; `GH_TOKEN` secret.

### Protocol & SPI
- **#87** (omnibase_spi): Implement `ProtocolNodeProjectionEffect` as synchronous `ProtocolEffect`—`execute()` must be synchronous; new contracts `ProtocolEffect`, `ProtocolNodeProjectionEffect`, `ContractProjectionResult`.
- **#310** (omnibase_spi): Dispatch protocol accepts optional `delivery` context—`dispatch()` and `dispatch_with_transaction()` gain keyword-only `delivery` defaulting `None`; envelope stays producer's truth.
- **#1234** (omnibase_core): Protocol-conformance tests—33 tests verifying 8 transport-surface Protocols importable/usable as `AsyncMock`/`MagicMock` spec; fix `transport_mock_lint.py --write-baseline` to emit portable relative paths via `_rel_path`.

### Model & Runtime
- **#3141** (omnimarket): Free `glm-4.5-flash` rung on z.ai general API—reachable only as tenant BYOK key; loader refuses paid IDs; zero-price model booked free; general-API surface in own contract.
- **#2965** (omnimarket): `onex local init` writes `runtime.lane` example to local-home (mode 0600), sets `config_source: local-home` in `~/.onex/config.yaml`; module at `model_local_runtime_lane.py`; 24 tests pass.
- **#3041** (omnimarket): Delegate-skill terminal carries ticket—migration 0047 adds nullable `delegation_events.ticket_id` + partial index; `HandlerDelegationTicketFold` returns column for well-formed ticket, nothing for absent, named refusal for malformed.

### Performance & Quality
- **#1918** (omnibase_core): Lazy-load `runtime`, `event_bus`, `models`, `protocols` inits—hook importing `RuntimeLocal` with `inmemory` bus paid ~1s import before 0.09s work; 174 package `__init__.py` files eager-re-exported subtrees.
- **#3155** (omnimarket): Drop two dead mypy overrides—`node_navigation_history_reducer` now stores `ModelONEXContainer`; `ignore_missing_imports` on `node_pr_lifecycle_*`/`node_pr_delegated_fix_effect` dead; contract FSM test covers `reduced` state.
- **#3515** (omnimarket): Re-bind AC3 to `-k s6_cutover` (was `compares_with_occ`); AC3 re-scoped to plan as executed; add AC4–AC6 (count bar 30, 13 case observations, drill readback) bound to new data file/test; decision under operator RULING 2026-10-07T09:47:32Z.
- **#2988** (omnimarket): Declare `classify_head_checks` on `node_pr_lifecycle_triage_compute` (contract 1.1.0) with `ModelHeadCheckFacts`, `ModelHeadCheckVerdict`, `EnumHeadCheckVerdict`; corpus: 48 real PR heads from 2026-09-26 hand-labelled.
